```{r}
# ---- Helper metrics ----
precision <- function(y_true, y_pred) {
  tp <- sum(y_true == 1 & y_pred == 1)
  fp <- sum(y_true == 0 & y_pred == 1)
  if ((tp + fp) == 0) return(0)
  tp / (tp + fp)
}
recall <- function(y_true, y_pred) {
  tp <- sum(y_true == 1 & y_pred == 1)
  fn <- sum(y_true == 1 & y_pred == 0)
  if ((tp + fn) == 0) return(0)
  tp / (tp + fn)
}
f1_from_pr <- function(p, r) {
  if ((p + r) == 0) return(0)
  2 * p * r / (p + r)
}

compute_best_threshold <- function(y_true, y_score, thresholds = seq(0,0.9,0.1), criterion = c("sum","f1","youden")) {
  criterion <- match.arg(criterion)
  results <- data.frame(threshold = thresholds, precision = NA, recall = NA, f1 = NA, youden = NA, metric = NA)
  for (i in seq_along(thresholds)) {
    t <- thresholds[i]
    y_pred <- as.integer(y_score >= t)
    p <- precision(y_true, y_pred)
    r <- recall(y_true, y_pred)
    f1v <- f1_from_pr(p, r)
    spec <- ifelse(sum(y_true == 0) == 0, NA, sum(y_true == 0 & y_pred == 0)/sum(y_true == 0))
    youden <- r + spec - 1
    results$precision[i] <- p
    results$recall[i] <- r
    results$f1[i] <- f1v
    results$youden[i] <- youden
    results$metric[i] <- switch(criterion, sum = p + r, f1 = f1v, youden = youden)
  }
  best_row <- results[which.max(results$metric), ]
  list(best_threshold = best_row$threshold,
       table = results,
       best_row = best_row)
}

# ---- CV + Ensemble Function ----
cross_validate_ensemble <- function(df, predictors, model_dir, k = 5, fit_model = TRUE, use_random_effects = TRUE, thresholds = seq(0,1,0.1), criterion = "f1", seed = 42) {
  
  set.seed(seed)
  if (!dir.exists(model_dir)) dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  folds <- createFolds(df$Real, k = k, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)
  
  fixed_effects <- paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")
  models <- vector("list", length(folds))
  fold_thresholds <- numeric(length(folds))
  n <- nrow(df)
  
  # Store OOF probabilities and fold predictions
  oof_probs <- numeric(n); oof_probs[] <- NA
  all_fold_binary <- matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = k)
  all_fold_probs <- matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = k)
  
  for (i in seq_along(folds)) {
    
    cat("Fold", i, "\n")
    val_idx <- folds[[i]]
    train_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(n), val_idx)
    
    # already been scaled on the full dataset
    df_train_scaled <- df[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    df_val_scaled <- df[val_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # standard scale
    # X_train_mean <- sapply(df_train[, predictors], mean, na.rm = TRUE)
    # X_train_sd <- sapply(df_train[, predictors], sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  
    # save(X_train_mean, file = file.path(model_dir, paste0("X_train_mean_", i, ".RData")))
    # save(X_train_sd, file = file.path(model_dir, paste0("X_train_sd_", i, ".RData")))
    
    # Scale training predictors
    # X_train_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(df_train[, predictors], center = X_train_mean, scale = X_train_sd))
    # X_val_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(df_val[, predictors], center = X_train_mean, scale = X_train_sd))

    # combine into dataframes
    # df_train_scaled = cbind(X_train_scaled, Real = df_train[['Real']], SampleID = df_train[['SampleID']])
    # df_val_scaled = cbind(X_val_scaled, SampleID = df_val[['SampleID']])

    # then cbind the original df_val with identifier columns
    # df_train_scaled = cbind(df_train_scaled, df_train[, c("POS", "REF", "ALT", "AF")])
    # df_val_scaled = cbind(df_val_scaled, df_val[, c("POS", "REF", "ALT", "AF")])
    
    formula_str <- if (use_random_effects) {
      paste0("Real ~ ", fixed_effects, " + (1 | SampleID)")
    } else {
      paste0("Real ~ ", fixed_effects)
    }
    model_formula <- as.formula(formula_str)
    
    if (fit_model) {
      model <- if (use_random_effects) {
        glmer(model_formula, data = df_train_scaled, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
      } else {
        glm(model_formula, data = df_train_scaled, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
      }
      save(model, file = file.path(model_dir, paste0("model_", i, ".RData")))
    } else {
      load(file.path(model_dir, paste0("model_", i, ".RData")))
    }
    
    models[[i]] <- model
    
    # Predict OOF for validation fold
    df_val_scaled$pred_prob <- predict(model, newdata = df_val_scaled, type = "response", allow.new.levels = TRUE)
    oof_probs[val_idx] <- df_val_scaled$pred_prob
    
    # Best threshold for this fold's validation
    # best_res <- compute_best_threshold(y_true = df_val_scaled$Real, y_score = df_val_scaled$pred_prob, thresholds = thresholds, criterion = criterion)
    # fold_thresholds[i] <- best_res$best_threshold
    
    # Predict on all samples using fold threshold for majority vote
    # all_probs <- predict(model, newdata = df_val_scaled, type = "response", allow.new.levels = TRUE)
    # all_fold_probs[, i] <- all_probs
    # all_fold_binary[, i] <- as.integer(all_probs >= fold_thresholds[i])
  }
  
  # Soft voting: average probabilities
  # soft_probs <- rowMeans(all_fold_probs)
  
  # Threshold based on OOF
  soft_thresh_res <- compute_best_threshold(y_true = df$Real, y_score = oof_probs, thresholds = thresholds, criterion = criterion)
  soft_threshold <- soft_thresh_res$best_threshold
  # soft_pred_class <- as.integer(soft_probs >= soft_threshold)
  
  # Majority voting
  # maj_vote_class <- as.integer(rowSums(all_fold_binary) > k/2)
  
  # df$soft_pred_class <- soft_pred_class
  # df$soft_prob <- soft_probs
  # df$maj_vote_class <- maj_vote_class
  
  list(
    # df = df,
    models = models,
    # fold_thresholds = fold_thresholds,
    soft_threshold = soft_threshold,
    oof_probs = oof_probs
    # all_fold_probs = all_fold_probs,
    # all_fold_binary = all_fold_binary
  )
}
```

```{r}
predict_ensemble <- function(newdata, models, soft_threshold, use_random_effects = TRUE) {
  k <- length(models)
  n <- nrow(newdata)
  
  # Matrices to store fold predictions
  all_fold_probs <- matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = k)
  all_fold_binary <- matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = k)
  
  for (i in seq_len(k)) {
    model <- models[[i]]
    
    # Predict probabilities
    probs <- predict(model, newdata = newdata, type = "response", allow.new.levels = TRUE)
    all_fold_probs[, i] <- probs
    # all_fold_binary[, i] <- as.integer(probs >= fold_thresholds[i])
  }
  
  # Soft voting: average probabilities
  soft_probs <- rowMeans(all_fold_probs)
  # If no soft_threshold supplied, default to 0.5
  soft_pred_class <- as.integer(soft_probs >= soft_threshold)
  
  # Majority voting
  # maj_vote_class <- as.integer(rowSums(all_fold_binary) > k/2)
  
  newdata$predicted <- soft_probs
  newdata$pred_class <- soft_pred_class
  
  # Return results
  newdata
}
```

```{r}
for (i in seq_along(res$models)) {
  model <- res$models[[i]]  # extract the i-th model
  
  tidy_model <- tidy(model, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, conf.method = "Wald", exponentiate = TRUE)

  # write.csv(tidy_model, paste(model_dir, "models", "model_summary.csv", sep=""), row.names=FALSE)

  term_labels <- c(
    "COV_RATIO" = "Coverage Ratio",
    "CLIPPED_BASES_RATIO" = "Clipped Bases Ratio",
    "DISCORDANT_READS_RATIO" = "Discordant Reads Ratio",
    "SAF_prop_deviation_from_half" = "Deviation from 50% Forward Reads",
    "Mean_BQ_ALT_Allele" = "Average Base Quality",
    "(Intercept)" = "Sample Random Effect"
  )
  
  plot = ggplot(tidy_model, aes(x = estimate, y = term)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = term_labels) +  # <--- change labels here
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = "Odds Ratio (95% CI)", y = NULL)

  # ggsave(paste(model_dir, "/forest_plot.svg", sep=""), plot = plot, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)

  View(tidy_model)
  
}
```
